label: Four shapes
about: Clockwise from top left: ponnuki (white), bamboo, empty triangle (white), tortoise shell.

label: Ponnuki (built up)
about: Starts empty. → plays a black stone at E5, then White surrounds it from all four sides. The fourth white stone captures, leaving the ponnuki: four stones around one empty point.

label: Bamboo joint (built up)
about: Starts empty. → plays two black pairs, D6–E6 and D4–E4, one line apart: the bamboo joint. White can't cut it: whichever of D5 and E5 White takes, Black takes the other.

label: Empty triangle (built up)
about: Starts empty. → plays three white stones, D6, D5 and E5, in an L around the empty point E6: the empty triangle. Then four black stones at C6, C5, D4 and E4 cut its liberties from 7 to 3 (D7, E6, F5): the stones crowd each other, so the shape is weak.

label: Tortoise shell (built up)
about: Starts empty. → plays two white stones, D5 and E5, then six black stones around them. The sixth captures both, leaving the tortoise shell: six stones around two empty points.
